title.narrative: Strengthening local women’s leadership and resilience in gender-just climate solutions and action across conflict settings - GAGGA

description.narrative: The purpose of the project is to support, analyse, document and advocate the gender-just climate solutions of women-led community-based organisations (CBOs) and women environmental and human rights defenders (WEHRDs) in the Global South experiencing structural violence and working at the nexus of climate injustice, gender injustice, and conflict.
